title: Abstention and routing evaluation harness
summary: How can a routing system abstain reliably on mixed, malformed, conflicting or out-of-domain requests without mistaking model confidence for authority?
evidence_level: Measured rule baselines and adversarial robustness on synthetic cases; no model results
contribution: Ilghar Dadgostari: problem framing, requirements and evaluation direction. Implementation AI-assisted (Grok Bot), reviewed only by Grok Bot so far.
architecture: Recorded or mocked model proposal adapter

results.caveat: test probes written by rule author; not blind

limitations: All items synthetic; no model was run.
Test probes written by the same author after the rule existed (not blind).
Historical laya-multilingual fixtures are summaries, not rerun, and measure different tasks.
Illustration (assets/ASSETS.json) is AI-generated, illustration only, stored on Drive not git; the native diagram is authoritative.
